_help: Rules are tried top to bottom against each form question (case-insensitive regular expression). First match wins. a = the answer; {{field}} is filled from profile.json, and an empty field means you are asked once instead. ASK = always ask you. DECLINE = choose the 'prefer not to say' option. SKIP = leave blank when optional. 'learned' holds answers you gave in the app (exact question text) and is checked before the rules.
